'''Kneely''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed on a Republic [[Space station/Legends|space station]] above [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kneely first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a security key vendor found on Ilum.
